Row.Text: Tuscany keeps its own civilization across the ages.
A Florentine navigator gave the hemisphere its name.
Napoleon annexed Tuscany and crowned himself king in Italy.
The Renaissance began by reading Rome, in the country Rome grew out of.
Greek scholars fleeing east brought Plato to Florence.
Machiavelli served the Florentine Republic for fourteen years.
The Florentine banks and the Florentine navigators followed the Atlantic crowns west.
A republic that made its fortune on other people's routes.
Lorenzo ruled Florence without ever holding office.
Own a Bank in 3 Settlements to unlock Tuscany, where the modern bank was invented.
Your bankers keep books in two columns and settle debts by letter across a continent. Florence did this first, and paid for a renaissance with the proceeds.
